prohibited.definition: Never, regardless of who asks, regardless of approval
prohibited.operator_involvement: None — the action cannot be performed

actions.text: Commit, push, or merge to main
Merge to develop (was suspended; now Prohibited)
Force push
Delete any long-lived branch
Create, modify, or delete a branch rule
Create, modify, or delete a required status check
Create, modify, or delete a merge control
Read, print, set, rotate, delete, or enumerate a secret value
Create, rotate, or widen any credential or token — except operator-provisioned, scoped credentials for read-only repo access when explicitly authorized
Hold or use a secret-store browsing tool
Print any infrastructure identifier in cleartext
Operate against the production database
Export production data
Access production logs without operator-supplied sanitized excerpts
Weaken, disable, skip, bypass, or reconfigure any control that blocked work
Record or report gate evidence for a run that did not execute the recorded gates
Push a branch carrying an unreverted change to a security control
Modify the gate chain itself without an approved work unit naming that change
Hold a persistent memory store containing architecture facts, approvals, or acceptance evidence — versioned repo files excluded
Provision any infrastructure resource
Add a domain to an allowlist
Modify a firewall rule
Modify a DNS record
Install any MCP server, plugin, hook, or extension
Enable or activate an MCP server that is present but disabled — exception: enabling a pre-installed, inert, operator-authorized extension is P-A-E
Write any file under _staging\issues\
Edit the body of an existing GitHub issue — moved to P-A-E
Delete a branch, worktree, or stash

pae.definition: Propose, Approve, Execute — per-action operator approval required

actions.text: Set priority on a project board item
Set work type on a project board item
Set backlog state on a project board item
Archive or unarchive a project board item
Edit the body of an existing GitHub issue
Close an existing GitHub issue
Reopen an existing GitHub issue
Add or remove labels on an existing GitHub issue
Add or remove assignees on an existing GitHub issue
Close a pull request without merging
Delete a remote feature branch (only the Agent's own feature branches)
Modify a file outside the assigned task's declared scope, if required to complete the task
Enable a pre-installed, inert MCP server, plugin, or extension

permitted.definition: Within scope of an assigned task, no per-action approval required

actions.text: Read any file in the workspace — except secret values and production material
Run any read-only command — except commands that would read secrets
Create new files in a scratch or assigned directory
Modify files within the declared scope of the current task
Run tests, gates, linters, and type checks
Push a feature branch (never to main or develop)
Open a pull request
Comment on pull requests and issues
Run gh read operations
Run git read operations
Create branches locally
Delete the Agent's own local scratch branches

pae_workflow.format:
PROPOSED ACTION
---------------
Action: <verb + object>
Scope: <single item, or explicit batch>
Rationale: <why this action>
Reversibility: <how to undo this action>
Dependencies: <what else is affected>
Evidence: <what the operator should inspect before approving>
AWAITING: operator approval
rules: One proposal per action. Batching only when explicitly requested.
No execution before approval. If approval does not come, the proposal sits.
Execute exactly what was approved. If the approved action differs, re-propose.
Report completion. Replace AWAITING with EXECUTED and add evidence.
Stale-approval rule: Approval binds to the exact proposed change and version reviewed.
